title: MrDocs DOM Schema
description: Schema for the DOM objects available to Handlebars templates in the MrDocs documentation generator.

NamespaceSymbol.description: A namespace declaration. The implicit global namespace appears as a namespace symbol with an empty name and no parent.

name.description: Unqualified name of the symbol, as written in the source.

loc.description: Source location information for the symbol's declaration and definition.

kind.description: Discriminator selecting the symbol kind (e.g. `"function"`, `"record"`). Each concrete symbol type constrains this field to a single literal value.

id.description: Stable, base64-encoded identifier used for cross-references between DOM objects.

access.description: Access specifier (`"public"`, `"protected"`, `"private"`); empty for namespace-scope members.

extraction.description: Why the symbol was extracted: `"regular"`, `"see-below"`, `"implementation-defined"`, or `"dependency"`.

isCopyFromInherited.description: True when the symbol is a synthesized copy of an inherited member (see the `inherit-base-members` configuration option).

parent.description: Identifier of the enclosing scope, or empty when the symbol lives in the global namespace.

doc.description: Parsed documentation comment attached to the symbol, or absent when the symbol is undocumented.

attributes.description: C++ attributes attached to the declaration, in source order.

isInline.description: True if the namespace is declared `inline`.

isAnonymous.description: True if the namespace has no name in source.

usingDirectives.description: List of `using namespace` directives found in this namespace's scope.

members.description: All members of the namespace, grouped into tranches by kind.

class.description: Tag set to the literal `"symbol"`. Lets templates discriminate symbol DOM objects from auxiliary types (`type`, `name`, etc.) without inspecting `kind`.

doc.description: Parsed documentation comment attached to the symbol, or absent when the symbol is undocumented.

attributes.description: C++ attributes attached to the declaration, in source order.

template.description: Template head if this is a class template; absent for non-templates.

isTypeDef.description: True when the record was introduced by an anonymous `typedef struct { ... } Name;` declaration.

isFinal.description: True if the class is declared `final`.

isFinalDestructor.description: True when the record's destructor is declared `final`.

bases.description: Direct base classes, in declaration order.

derived.description: Identifiers of records that derive from this one and appear in the corpus.

interface.description: Per-access summary of the record's members (public, protected, private, plus aggregated views).

friends.description: List of friend declarations attached to the record.

isListedOnPrimary.description: True when this is a record-template specialization rendered under its primary template and suppressed from the parent scope's listing.

specializations.description: Identifiers of the record-template specializations whose primary is this record template.

deductionGuides.description: Identifiers of the deduction guides for this record template.

class.description: Tag set to the literal `"symbol"`. Lets templates discriminate symbol DOM objects from auxiliary types (`type`, `name`, etc.) without inspecting `kind`.

FunctionSymbol.description: A function declaration, including free functions, member functions, constructors, destructors, and user-defined operators.

name.description: Unqualified name of the symbol, as written in the source.

loc.description: Source location information for the symbol's declaration and definition.

kind.description: Discriminator selecting the symbol kind (e.g. `"function"`, `"record"`). Each concrete symbol type constrains this field to a single literal value.

id.description: Stable, base64-encoded identifier used for cross-references between DOM objects.

access.description: Access specifier (`"public"`, `"protected"`, `"private"`); empty for namespace-scope members.

extraction.description: Why the symbol was extracted: `"regular"`, `"see-below"`, `"implementation-defined"`, or `"dependency"`.

isCopyFromInherited.description: True when the symbol is a synthesized copy of an inherited member (see the `inherit-base-members` configuration option).

parent.description: Identifier of the enclosing scope, or empty when the symbol lives in the global namespace.

doc.description: Parsed documentation comment attached to the symbol, or absent when the symbol is undocumented.

attributes.description: C++ attributes attached to the declaration, in source order.

returnType.description: Return type. Absent for constructors and destructors.

params.description: Function parameter list, in declaration order.

template.description: Template head if this is a function template; absent for non-templates.

funcClass.description: Special-function classification (`"constructor"`, `"destructor"`, `"conversion"`, etc.) or empty for ordinary functions.

isVariadic.description: True when the function accepts a C-style `...` argument list.

isDefaulted.description: True when the function is `= default`.

isExplicitlyDefaulted.description: True when the function carries an explicit `= default` in source (not just an implicit defaulted special member).

isDeleted.description: True when the function is `= delete` (whether written explicitly or implied by language rules).

isDeletedAsWritten.description: True only when the function is `= delete` as written in source; distinguishes user-deleted from implicitly deleted.

hasOverrideAttr.description: True when the function carries the `override` specifier.

hasTrailingReturn.description: True when the function uses trailing-return-type syntax (`auto ... -> T`).

isExplicitObjectMemberFunction.description: True when the function declares an explicit object parameter (deducing-this member function).

overloadedOperator.description: Overloaded operator name (e.g. `"operator+"`) or empty if not an operator.

isRecordMethod.description: True when the function is a member of a class, struct, or union.

isVirtual.description: True when the function is virtual (whether by `virtual` keyword or by overriding a virtual function).

isVirtualAsWritten.description: True only when the `virtual` keyword appears in source.

isPure.description: True when the function is pure virtual (`= 0`).

isConst.description: True when the function is a `const` member function.

isVolatile.description: True when the function is a `volatile` member function.

isFinal.description: True when the function is declared `final`.

refQualifier.description: Reference qualifier on the implicit object parameter: `"&"`, `"&&"`, or empty.

explicit.description: Rendered `explicit` specifier (with optional condition) for constructors and conversion functions.

functionObjectImpl.description: Identifier of the function object this function is the call-operator implementation of, when the `auto-function-objects` feature recognized it as such; empty otherwise.

isListedOnPrimary.description: True when this is a function-template specialization rendered under its primary template and suppressed from the parent scope's listing.

specializations.description: Identifiers of the function-template specializations whose primary is this function template.

class.description: Tag set to the literal `"symbol"`. Lets templates discriminate symbol DOM objects from auxiliary types (`type`, `name`, etc.) without inspecting `kind`.

Type.description: A C++ type. The DOM serializes the most-derived kind (named, pointer, reference, array, function, etc.); see the `oneOf` entries for the per-kind shape.

Name.description: A (possibly qualified) name occurring in source, such as the name of a base class or the type referenced by a `NamedType`.

TParam.description: A template parameter of a templated symbol. The DOM serializes the most-derived kind (type, non-type, template); see the `oneOf` entries for the per-kind shape.

TArg.description: A template argument supplied to a template specialization. The DOM serializes the most-derived kind (type, non-type, template); see the `oneOf` entries for the per-kind shape.

Block.description: A block-level node in a parsed documentation comment (paragraphs, lists, headings, and command blocks like `@brief` / `@param` / `@returns`).

Inline.description: An inline-level node in a parsed documentation comment (text, emphasis, code spans, references, etc.).

Attribute.description: A C++ attribute attached to a symbol. The concrete kinds (`deprecated`, `nodiscard`, ...) extend this with their evaluated arguments.

Location.description: A source location (file path plus line/column).

shortPath.description: Path relative to the configured source root, suitable for display.

sourcePath.description: Path relative to the source-root setting, used for documentation cross-references.

documented.description: True when a doc comment was attached at this location.

name.description: Parameter name as written in the declaration. Empty for unnamed parameters.

default.description: Default argument expression as written, or absent if the parameter has no default.

TemplateInfo.description: Template metadata attached to a templated symbol: parameters, arguments (for specializations), and a reference to the primary template.

params.description: Template parameter list, in declaration order.

args.description: Template arguments applied to the primary template, in declaration order. Present on (partial) specializations and instantiations; empty for the primary template itself.

requires.description: Trailing `requires`-clause expression as written; empty when the template has no constraints.

primary.description: Identifier of the primary template this entry specializes; empty when this is itself the primary.

SourceInfo.description: Source-location metadata for a symbol: every declaration site plus the definition site, when one exists.

defLoc.description: Location of the symbol's definition; absent when no definition was extracted.

loc.description: Locations of the symbol's declarations (one entry per source declaration).

BaseInfo.description: A base-class clause of a class or struct declaration.

type.description: Base type as written in the inheritance clause (a class or template specialization).

access.description: Access specifier of the base (`"public"`, `"protected"`, or `"private"`).

isVirtual.description: True when the base is inherited virtually.

FriendInfo.description: A `friend` declaration appearing inside a class or struct.

type.description: Type befriended, used when the friend declaration names a type rather than a corpus symbol.

id.description: Identifier of the symbol befriended when it lives in the corpus; empty when the friend points outside it.
